Setup.title: Set Up TokFresh
Setup.step1Description: Authorize TokFresh to trigger API calls with your Claude subscription.
Setup.step1RequiresDescription: You need an active Claude Pro or Max subscription to use this service.
Setup.step1AfterAuth: After authorizing on claude.ai, you'll see an authorization code. Copy and paste it below.
Setup.step1Privacy: Your token is exchanged in your browser only and sent directly to your Cloudflare account. TokFresh never collects or stores it.
Setup.step1SessionExpired: Session expired. Please connect Claude again.
Setup.step2Description: Choose when your 5-hour token cycles should start.
Setup.step2SkipNote: The 5th trigger is skipped because 5 × 5h = 25h exceeds 24h. It would overlap with the next day's first cycle, making both ineffective.
Setup.step3Description: Get notified when the token timer is triggered.
Setup.step4Description: Deploy a worker to your Cloudflare account that runs automatically.
Setup.step4TokenDescription: Click the button below to create a token with the right permissions pre-configured.
Setup.step4TokenAfter: After creating the token, copy and paste it below.
Setup.step4Privacy: This token is used once to deploy the worker, then discarded. TokFresh never stores your Cloudflare credentials.
Setup.step4SubdomainDescription: Your Cloudflare account needs a workers.dev subdomain. Open the Workers dashboard once to create it automatically.
Setup.step4ObservabilityDescription: Enables log and trace collection via Cloudflare's observability settings. With at most 4 executions per day, usage stays well within the free tier (200K events/day).
Setup.successDescription: Your token scheduler is deployed and running.
Setup.successOffNote: Your computer can be off — the worker runs automatically on Cloudflare's edge network!
Setup.subscribeDescription: Your worker runs a fixed code snapshot. If Anthropic changes their API headers, OAuth policy, or model endpoints, your scheduler will break silently. Leave your email and we'll notify you when a re-setup is needed.
Setup.subscribeSuccess: You're subscribed! We'll only email you when action is needed.
Setup.subscribeError: Failed to subscribe. Please try again.
Setup.onboardingStep1Description: Claude Pro/Max resets every 5 hours from your first call. If that cycle starts at 9 AM, you only get 2 sessions during work hours. Start it at 6 AM and you get 3 — that's 50% more tokens without changing how you work.
Setup.onboardingStep2Description: Without TokFresh, you hit the limit mid-task and wait hours. With TokFresh, limits refresh while you're deep in a session. No interruption — set your start time and every cycle aligns to your routine.
Setup.onboardingStep3Point1: Connect your Claude account via OAuth — no API keys needed
Setup.onboardingStep3Point2: Choose when your 5-hour cycles start — full schedule is auto-calculated
Setup.onboardingStep3Point3: Deploy a worker to your free Cloudflare account — runs forever at zero cost
Setup.onboardingStep3Safety: We never store your tokens. Everything is processed in your browser.

SetupFaq.title: Common Questions
SetupFaq.faq1Question: Will this get my account banned?
SetupFaq.faq1Answer: No TOS violation. It's a single API call to trigger the reset timer — the same thing that happens when you use Claude normally.
SetupFaq.faq2Answer: Claude Pro/Max resets every 5 hours from first use. If that cycle starts at the wrong time, your limit hits mid-workday. TokFresh pre-triggers it so the limit refreshes while you're deep in a session — giving you more usable session windows.
SetupFaq.faq3Answer: Runs within Cloudflare Workers free tier. No ongoing cost.
SetupFaq.faq4Question: Can I turn it off anytime?
SetupFaq.faq4Answer: Delete the worker from your Cloudflare dashboard and it stops immediately.
